line: You asked, so I answer. Keeps-What-Floats drinks with me at the bench by the water until the lamps are low.
Then he sleeps on a bedroll under the eaves of the shacks, north-west of the house. He runs from a shout. Keep quiet.
You ask plainly, so I will answer you plainly. Keeps-What-Floats drinks with me at the bench by the water until the lamps are low.
Then he sleeps on a bedroll under the eaves of the shacks, north-west of the house.
He runs from any shout, so keep your voice down.
